g1.necessity: Slices 1-3 landed the fleet lease lifecycle inside SubAgentRunner (run-boundary acquire, per-turn fail-soft renew, fenced settle, subagent_lease tool) but the production factory never constructed a ProjectCoordinator, so the whole capability was inert in production and the tool honestly reported not-wired. An explicit construction wiring with an off-by-default gate is required to expose it without forcing fleet behavior on default installs.

g2.non_duplication: Adds four settings fields and one construction branch. No new store, no second coordination authority, no liveness/heartbeat controller, no takeover policy: fencing stays per-lease generation via FleetStore CAS, cross-generation takeover stays the already-reviewed reclaim path, and owner_id remains a per-process mechanical token.

No secret, schema migration, or service state is involved.
